change_summary: The journal issued an expression of concern saying the editors were made aware of concerns about some of the data reported in the article. The matter is being looked into and readers will be updated later. The notice does not say which data are concerned.
evaluation: Your Discussion cites Lopez and Chen [8] as showing reduced activity in recipient mice, in support of a causal role of gut bacteria in depressive behaviour, and says your own proposal builds on this finding. The stored paper reports that transplanting gut bacteria from depressed donors made recipient mice less active in a forced-swim test, citing Figure 3, which shows immobility time. The journal's notice says the editors were made aware of concerns about some of the data reported in the article, but it does not say which data. It is therefore uncertain whether the immobility result you rely on is touched; counting it as possibly affected, the impact on your draft is medium because the finding is central to your Discussion argument. The journal says the matter is being looked into and readers will be updated.
recommendation: Your Discussion cites Lopez and Chen [8] as showing reduced activity in recipient mice, in support of a causal role of gut bacteria in depressive behaviour, and says your own proposal builds on this finding. The journal's notice says the editors were made aware of concerns about some of the data reported in the article, but it does not say which data. Hedge the Discussion wording, avoid building further on this finding, and cite the expression of concern next to reference [8]. The journal says the matter is being looked into and readers will be updated. Tracking continues, so a retraction or correction would raise a new alert.
